checks.name: Late success cannot overwrite the latest input
Late failure cannot replace the latest result
Input snapshot rejects an edited value before its next lookup
Invalid input clears the old result without sending

Recommended CMYK preserves mode, profile, calibration and values
Invalidation or closing prevents a pending result from reappearing
